## Summary

Describe the smallest useful change.

## Evidence

- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] `entropy-leaderboard validate`
- [ ] `entropy-leaderboard render --check`
- [ ] Paper/slides rebuilt if their sources changed
- [ ] No secrets, model weights, private corpora, caches, or generated bytecode added

## Leaderboard changes

If applicable, provide the benchmark ID, immutable model/tokenizer revisions, source-result SHA-256, and contamination audit.
